title: PowerPro Spectra Braid
seoTitle: PowerPro Braid Diameter Chart & Reel Capacity Guide | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Choose a PowerPro Spectra strength and reel to estimate capacity, calculate mono backing, compare diameters, and plan the right retail spool size.
excerpt: The original four-carrier PowerPro, made with Spectra fiber. A thin, low-stretch main line for freshwater and saltwater setups, with a wide choice of strengths. This guide covers original PowerPro, not Super8Slick V2 or Maxcuatro.

title: Seaguar InvizX Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Seaguar InvizX Diameter Chart & Reel Capacity Guide | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Choose an InvizX strength and reel to estimate full-spool capacity, check whether 200 yards is enough, plan backing, and compare exact diameters.
excerpt: A 100% fluorocarbon main line for freshwater fishing, offered from 4 to 25 lb. Seaguar positions InvizX around soft handling and low memory. Plan a full fluorocarbon fill or a shorter working section over mono backing; a short leader on braid is a different setup.

title: Berkley Trilene XL Monofilament
seoTitle: Trilene XL Diameter Chart & Reel Capacity Guide | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Check Berkley Trilene XL diameters from 2 to 30 lb, estimate how much fits your reel, compare other mono lines, and plan a full fill or optional backing.
excerpt: Berkley's smooth-casting nylon monofilament, available in a wide range of strengths. This guide covers Trilene XL, not Trilene XT, Big Game, or Trilene fluorocarbon. The chart uses the current U.S. filler and bulk lineup, with package length matched to each strength.

title: Seaguar Tatsu Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Seaguar Tatsu Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar Tatsu diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: Tatsu is Seaguar's double-structure fluorocarbon main line. Two fluorocarbon resins are combined in one line, with Seaguar emphasizing suppleness and strength. This guide covers the listed 4-25 lb sizes and helps you budget a full fill or a working section over backing.

title: Seaguar AbrazX Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Seaguar AbrazX Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar AbrazX diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: AbrazX is Seaguar's abrasion-focused fluorocarbon main line. The manufacturer positions it for fishing around cover such as rocks, docks, and timber. Its 4-25 lb range includes very different diameters, so select a strength before checking reel capacity or buying a spool.

title: Seaguar Red Label Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Seaguar Red Label Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar Red Label diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: Red Label is Seaguar's value-oriented fluorocarbon main line, with manufacturer positioning aimed at baitcasting reels. The current range runs from 4 to 20 lb. Package length changes at the heavy end, so a Red Label spool is not automatically a 200-yard spool.

title: Seaguar Smackdown Braid
seoTitle: Seaguar Smackdown Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar Smackdown diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: Smackdown is an eight-strand braid. This guide uses Seaguar's current Stealth Gray diameter chart and assigned 150- and 300-yard variants. Select an exact strength to compare spool capacity and plan a braid working length over mono backing.

title: Seaguar BRAWLR Monofilament
seoTitle: Seaguar BRAWLR Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar BRAWLR diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: BRAWLR is Seaguar's announced monofilament line, listed from 2 to 30 lb. Seaguar describes a temperature-controlled manufacturing process called PTD. This is a specification-based planning guide; a listing or capacity estimate does not establish retail availability or independent performance results.

title: Seaguar JDM R18 Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Seaguar JDM R18 Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar JDM R18 diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: JDM R18 Mainline is Seaguar's Japan-market fluorocarbon offered through its JDM collection. It uses two fluorocarbon resins and comes on 100-meter spools, labeled approximately 109 yards. The range includes intermediate strengths such as 5, 7, and 14 lb.

title: Seaguar JDM PEX8 Braid
seoTitle: Seaguar JDM PEX8 Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar JDM PEX8 diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: JDM PEX8 is Seaguar's eight-strand metered braid for finesse-oriented applications. It pairs a pink main color with contrasting green markings and is offered on 200-meter spools, labeled approximately 219 yards. Its six strengths run from 12 to 33 lb.

title: Sunline FC Sniper Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Sunline FC Sniper Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Find Sunline FC Sniper diameters by strength. Calculate your reel's full-spool amount, plan backing, and compare exact lines and package lengths.
excerpt: FC Sniper is Sunline's fluorocarbon main line for spinning and casting tackle. Its closely spaced lighter strengths make it useful to compare when planning a finesse setup, while the heavier end covers very different spool-space requirements. Select the actual strength before checking capacity: a 200-yard package is not offered throughout the range.

title: Sunline Shooter Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Sunline Shooter Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Find Sunline Shooter diameters by strength. Calculate your reel's full-spool amount, plan backing, and compare exact lines and package lengths.
excerpt: Shooter is Sunline's fluorocarbon range divided into Finesse Special, Marionette Special, and Power Special. The US listing changes both category and package length across the strength range. This page keeps those exact diameters and retail lengths together for full-spool or backing plans.

title: Sunline Assassin FC Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Sunline Assassin FC Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Find Sunline Assassin FC diameters by strength. Calculate your reel's full-spool amount, plan backing, and compare exact lines and package lengths.
excerpt: Assassin FC is Sunline's P-Ion-processed fluorocarbon main line. The current US range starts at 8 lb and uses a 225-yard retail package, making its purchase planning different from a typical 200-yard fluorocarbon spool. Its diameters also differ from FC Sniper at matching strengths.

title: Sunline Super Natural Monofilament
seoTitle: Sunline Super Natural Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Find Sunline Super Natural diameters by strength. Calculate your reel's full-spool amount, plan backing, and compare exact lines and package lengths.
excerpt: Super Natural is Sunline's nylon monofilament, available in retail and bulk lengths. The standard 330- and 660-yard listings cover 4-30 lb; the 3,300-yard listing extends to heavier strengths. That broad range includes very different line diameters, not one universal mono setup.

title: Sunline SX1 Braid
seoTitle: Sunline SX1 Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Find Sunline SX1 diameters by strength. Calculate your reel's full-spool amount, plan backing, and compare exact lines and package lengths.
excerpt: SX1 is Sunline's ULT-PE braid. Its US listing includes 125-, 250-, and 600-yard packages, but not at every strength and color. A short SX1 package may suit a working section over backing even when the reel's full braid capacity is much larger.

title: Sunline Xplasma Asegai Braid
seoTitle: Sunline Xplasma Asegai Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Find Sunline Xplasma Asegai diameters by strength. Calculate your reel's full-spool amount, plan backing, and compare exact lines and package lengths.
excerpt: Xplasma Asegai is Sunline's eight-strand PE braid with a plasma-treated surface. This guide uses current assigned US variants, including intermediate strengths such as 16 and 18 lb. The selected strength controls the diameter and available package lengths used in the spool plan.

title: Sunline Siglon PE X8 Braid
seoTitle: Sunline Siglon PE X8 Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Find Sunline Siglon PE X8 diameters by strength. Calculate your reel's full-spool amount, plan backing, and compare exact lines and package lengths.
excerpt: Siglon PE X8 is Sunline's eight-strand braid. Its current US chart includes very thin light-strength entries and heavier bulk-only options. Compare the numeric diameter rather than a generic mono-equivalent label when checking how much fits on your reel.

title: Sunline Machinegun Cast Monofilament
seoTitle: Sunline Machinegun Cast Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Find Sunline Machinegun Cast diameters by strength. Calculate your reel's full-spool amount, plan backing, and compare exact lines and package lengths.
excerpt: Shooter Machinegun Cast is nylon monofilament, not Shooter fluorocarbon. This guide covers the current Japanese-market Plasma Rise version. Its package lengths are printed in meters, with 150-meter and 100-meter sizes depending on strength; the calculator converts those lengths to yards.

title: Sunline BMS Azayaka FC Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Sunline BMS Azayaka FC Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Find Sunline BMS Azayaka FC diameters by strength. Calculate your reel's full-spool amount, plan backing, and compare exact lines and package lengths.
excerpt: Shooter BMS Azayaka FC is marked fluorocarbon main line. This guide covers the version launched in May 2026, with 80-meter and 320-meter packages. Its color sequence helps distinguish it from clear fluorocarbon and from the separate BMS Azayaka NY nylon product.

title: Berkley GINCLEAR Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Berkley GINCLEAR Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Find Berkley GINCLEAR diameters by strength. Calculate your reel's full-spool amount, plan backing, and compare exact lines and package lengths.
excerpt: GINCLEAR is Berkley's fluorocarbon for main-line use or a shock leader on braid. Berkley emphasizes handling and level-wound packaging. This guide uses the exact US variant diameters and package lengths, so the line's role and strength stay clear when planning a fill.
